January 1 2000 was a Saturday.  
From 1 Jan 2000 to 1 Jan 2026 spans 26 years containing exactly 7 leap days (2000, 2004, \ldots, 2024).  
Total day shift = 26 + 7 = 33 ≡ 5 (mod 7).  
Saturday + 5 days = Thursday.  

(The same result follows from the known Monday of 1 Jan 2024: two years plus the 2024 leap day shift the weekday by 3, again yielding Thursday.)

Answer: Thursday
